message: cannot assign to `n` from inside a lambda: the lambda captured its value, not the binding
label: `n` was captured, not shared

related.label: `n` is bound outside the lambda, here

notes: a closure captures by value when its record is built, so a later `set` inside it could never be observed outside; this used to pass `check` and fail inside codegen as AX4002
help: return the new value instead, or restructure so the assignment happens where the binding lives
